content.value: A manufacturing unit has two machines, both of which are equally likely to fail every (14) [CO2] 20 hours on average. Repairs take an average of 4 hours (exponentially distributed).
i) Formulate this situation as a birth-death process.
ii) Compute the expected downtime for both machines together.
